name: How long does an obstetric malpractice lawsuit take?

mainEntity.name: How long does an obstetric malpractice lawsuit take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an obstetric malpractice lawsuit can vary significantly, depending on the complexity of the case, the severity of the injuries, and whether it settles or goes to trial. Some cases may resolve within a year or two through settlement, while others, particularly those that proceed to trial, can take several years to conclude. Factors like the number of defendants, expert witness testimony, and court schedules also influence the timeline. Your attorney can provide a more specific estimate once they understand the details of your situation.
acceptedAnswer.description: The duration varies, typically ranging from one to several years, depending on case complexity, severity of injuries, and whether it settles or goes to trial.
